label: Java Backend
cardNote: ☕ Services built to remain maintainable over time
headline: Java services built for real workloads,
with failures that are visible and easier to fix.
summary: For Java services, I think beyond the successful request: what happens to the data when requests arrive together, where errors are recorded, and how an API change affects its clients. I bring tests and observability in early instead of waiting for a production problem.

freelance: Built Java backend services and shared components, choosing the framework and database around the needs of each project.
Worked from requirements and design through implementation and service debugging, using coding agents only with tests and code review.
security: Used vulnerability and patching experience in validation, error handling, dependency review, and service access boundaries.
Fixed security issues in code and configuration and wrote test cases to check the result.
company: Worked on distributed mobile and web applications with NoSQL databases and took part in their technical decisions.
Designed and maintained APIs shared by several clients and coordinated data-model changes across them.
